description: This file manages MCP server configurations, including listing, setting, and unsetting MCP servers, with validation and file replacement functionalities.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: normalizeConfiguredMcpServers
methods.description: Normalizes input into a ConfigMcpServers object, filtering out non-record entries.

methods.name: listConfiguredMcpServers
methods.description: Reads the current MCP server configuration snapshot and returns the list of configured servers.

methods.name: setConfiguredMcpServer
methods.description: Sets or updates an MCP server configuration, validating and replacing the config file.

methods.name: unsetConfiguredMcpServer
methods.description: Removes an MCP server configuration by name, validating and updating the config file.
